purpose: A simple lead-capture form page for enterprise/business sales inquiries, embedding a real third-party Tally form.

motion.detail: embedded Tally iframe is a real third-party outbound integration (src/motion/contact-form.js); this is a deliberate exception to the router's no-outbound-links constraint (see registry.manifest.json structuralNotes)

thirdPartyEmbed.note: This section embeds a real, live third-party form widget. A generator reusing this section contract for a different brand must swap in that brand's own real form endpoint, never submit to Granola's live Tally form.
